hypothesis.claim: Selecting the sleeve on low pairwise correlation and sector balance, instead of on dollar volume, produces a book that holds more effective bets and whose value swings less day to day, for the same kind of market exposure.
hypothesis.claimAr: اختيار السلة حسب انخفاض الارتباط الزوجي والتوازن القطاعي، بدلًا من حجم التداول، يُنتج محفظة تحتوي على عدد أكبر من الرهانات الفعّالة وتقلبها اليومي أقل، لنفس نوع التعرّض للسوق.
hypothesis.falsifier: Mean effective-bet ratio below 1.10, OR any single formation cycle below 1.00, OR volatility reduction below 5%, OR a paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound on sigma_B/sigma_A above 0.95.
hypothesis.priorEvidence: Walk-forward, 8 formation dates 2017-2024, trailing-252d formation and next-252d measurement: lower realized correlation in 8 of 8 out-of-sample periods, mean effective-bet ratio 1.28x.
hypothesis.returnClaim: NONE. No return, Sharpe, edge, or outperformance claim is made or permitted for this version, in either direction. The return difference needs 89-503 years of data for 80% power and is beyond measurement.
